# Marco Montalto Monella

> Personal website and blog of Marco Montalto Monella, a software engineer based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Currently at Pure Storage, formerly a Production Engineer on Core Data at Meta. Alumnus of NYU and Politecnico di Torino.

Marco is a software engineer who builds infrastructure at scale. He cares about innovation, health, and the environment. Outside of work he does gymnastics, beach volleyball, and running.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mmmarco.com/): Overview of who Marco is, what drives him, his journey, and how to get in touch.
- [Blog](https://mmmarco.com/blog/): Thoughts on software engineering, technology, and life.
- [Contact](https://mmmarco.com/contact/): Contact form for getting in touch.

## Blog posts

- [How Claude Rebuilt This Website](https://mmmarco.com/post/how-claude-rebuilt-this-website/): The story of how I teamed up with an AI assistant to redesign and modernize my personal website from scratch.
